newsitem.title: UK: Hattersley fined for letting dog kill goose.
newsitem.headline: Hattersley fined for letting dog kill goose.

text.p: Roy Hattersley, former deputy leader of Britain's Labour Party, was fined 75 pounds on Wednesday because his dog killed a goose in London's St James' Park.
Hattersley did not attend the five-minute court hearing, but pleaded guilty by letter to allowing his pet, Buster, off the leash in April.
Buster seized one of the park's greylag geese, which police later found badly injured and close to death.
Hattersley had accidentally let go of Buster and "was naturally most disturbed that his dog had killed a goose and very much regretted that." said a court clerk.
